plainTranslation: A's dreams meets B's drive. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
summaryDeep: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
